extracted.name: Fritata simplica
extracted.description: Basic fritata, any vegetables or meat, can use any kind of cheese, but basic is parmesan cheese
ingredient_lines: 200 g cut kani or crab stick
instruction_lines: In a saute pan heat up small amount of oil, then and butter saute all the veggies and the meat that you prefer. Off in the stove, and set aside
On the mixing bowl beat the eggs and add the cream, dash it with little amount of salt and pepper. Transfer the sauteed veggies and meat in a baking pan
Pour the egg and cream mix, arrange the mixture well even in the pan pour some grated cheese and cream cheese
Bake in the oven for 15 mins. In 176 F
